tools.name: searchApartments
tools.description:
Search Landing furnished apartments by city and dates. Navigates to the search results page (/s/{market}/apartments).
Use when the user wants to find a place to stay in a Landing market.

Stay types:
- Fixed: pass endDate as YYYY-MM-DD.
- Flex (open-ended): pass endDate as the literal string "indefinite" AND a committedNights tier — typically 90, 180, or 365 (3, 6, or 12 months). Longer commitments unlock larger discounts (exact amounts vary by home — call getFlexOptions for details). Members can transfer between any of Landing’s 250+ furnished homes with two weeks’ notice.
The exact tiers a home accepts vary (e.g. a 90-night-minimum home rejects the 1-month tier). Call getFlexOptions for the home before quoting a tier to the user.
If the user is "flexible" without picking a length, default to committedNights=180.

city.description: City to search (e.g. "Birmingham, AL", "Austin"). Resolved against Landing display cities — the first match wins; the tool returns the resolved name/slug so you can confirm.

endDate.description: Move-out date (YYYY-MM-DD) OR the literal string "indefinite" for Flex stays.

committedNights.description: Only valid with endDate="indefinite". Picks the Flex tier (1/3/6/12 months).
